environment.description: Same Actix-web service deployed behind AWS ALB. pgBouncer 1.21 configured with pool_mode=statement (statement-level pooling). In statement pooling mode, pgBouncer disallows multi-statement queries and protocol-level prepared statements; each client request is treated as a single simple query dispatched to any available backend connection. The PostgreSQL backend has standard_conforming_strings=on and the app_user role is restricted via a row-level security policy, but critically the pgBouncer statement-mode configuration rejects any query containing semicolons as a protocol violation since it cannot safely multiplex multi-statement transactions across backends.

config.network: Internal ALB, no direct internet access, accessed via API Gateway
config.db_user_privileges: GRANT SELECT ON products TO app_user; Row-level security enabled on sensitive tables
